label: The CEGAR loop
subgoals: Concretize the abstract counterexample on the real design
Refine when the counterexample is spurious and repeat

label: Existential abstraction
subgoals: Map each concrete state to its visible variables
Add an abstract edge for every concrete edge, reachable or not
Search the abstract graph from the abstract initial states

label: Spurious counterexamples and refinement
subgoals: Locate the abstract step that no concrete transition can produce
Use the unsat core of the concrete check to choose what to make visible
Re-run the abstract check with the refined model
